mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO seckill_reservation(seckill_id, user_phone) VALUES (#{seckillId}, #{userPhone})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM seckill_reservation WHERE seckill_id = #{seckillId} AND user_phone = #{userPhone}
mapper.select: SELECT id, seckill_id, user_phone, status, create_time FROM seckill_reservation WHERE user_phone = #{userPhone} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT id, seckill_id, user_phone, status, create_time FROM seckill_reservation WHERE seckill_id = #{seckillId} AND status = 0 ORDER BY create_time ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE seckill_reservation SET status = 1 WHERE seckill_id = #{seckillId} AND status = 0
